results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if property string is uncertain/empty or 403 occurs)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate accessible properties using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES (select and reuse the returned site_url exactly).
[Optional (if diagnosing permission/property mismatch)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the chosen property is readable using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITE.
[Required] [Step]: Sanity-check window totals using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (dimensions=[] to confirm metrics exist before detailed pulls).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve query breakdown using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (dimensions=['query']; paginate with start_row until rows is short/empty).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve page breakdown using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (dimensions=['page']; paginate with start_row using the same stop condition).

[Optional (if attribution/trends/large exports)] [Next Step]: Re-run GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (e.g., dimensions=['query','page'] or ['date'] and/or dimension_filter_groups) and aggregate in COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH; for diagnostics use GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL and GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS + GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITEMAP (use GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SUBMIT_SITEMAP only after explicit confirmation).

[Fallback (if 403, empty rows, INVALID_ARGUMENT/invalidParameter, or oversized output)] [Fallback]: Retry GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY with an alternate property from GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES and reduced complexity (fewer dimensions/filters, smaller row_limit, remove/adjust aggregation_type).
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES] Downstream queries can fail or return empty unless the property string is reused exactly as returned (property variants matter).
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] Successful responses may omit data.rows entirely; treat missing rows as valid no-data and null-check before iterating.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] ctr is returned as a 0–1 ratio; for rollups recompute CTR as total_clicks/total_impressions (don’t average row ctr).
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] rows[].keys is positional and matches requested dimensions order; dimensions=[] may have no keys even when metrics exist.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL] Requests fail validation if inspection_url is missing or misnamed; supply inspection_url explicitly.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Compute rollups with recomputed CTR and impression-weighted position.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
def rollup(rows):
 c=sum((r.get('clicks') or 0) for r in (rows or []))
 i=sum((r.get('impressions') or 0) for r in (rows or []))
 w=sum((r.get('position') or 0)*(r.get('impressions') or 0) for r in (rows or []))
 return {'clicks':c,'impressions':i,'ctr':(c/i if i else 0.0),'position':(w/i if i else 0.0)}
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Google Search Console provides tools to monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot your site's presence in Google Search results.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=google_search_console. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="google_search_console") to create a connection BEFORE executing any google_search_console tools.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_Q.description: Queries Google Search Console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, CTR, and position metrics. Only returns URLs with at least one impression; missing rows do not confirm non-indexing. Position is an impression-weighted average rank.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

site_url.description: The site's URL, including protocol (e.g., https://www.example.com/) or a domain property (e.g., sc-domain:example.com). URL-prefix properties specify exact protocol and path, while domain properties aggregate data across all subdomains and protocols.

row_limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Must be between 1 and 25,000. Note: The API returns top results sorted by clicks (or date when grouping by date). Must be between 1 and 5000. Use start_row to paginate; stop when response rows < row_limit.

start_row.description: The first row to return from the result set. Used for pagination.

dimensions.description: The dimensions to group the data by. Results are sorted by clicks descending, except when grouping by date (sorted by date ascending).

start_date.description: The start date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Data lags 2–3 days (UTC); most recent 1–2 days may be incomplete. Data retention is ~16 months; older ranges return zero rows.

search_type.description: The search type to filter results by.

dimension_filter_groups.description: Optional filters to apply to dimensions. Each filter group contains an array of filters with structure: [{'filters': [{'dimension': 'country', 'operator': 'equals', 'expression': 'USA'}]}]. Operators: equals, notEquals, contains, notContains, includingRegex, excludingRegex. Invalid dimension names, unsupported operators, or mismatched expressions return zero rows without an error — verify each filter before trusting empty results.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES.description: Lists all verified sites (properties) owned by the authenticated user in Google Search Console. Response contains a siteEntry array — always iterate it, never assume a single object. Each entry includes permissionLevel, which varies per site; do not assume owner-level access for all returned properties. When calling downstream tools, use the site_url value exactly as returned, including protocol, subdomain, sc-domain: prefix, and trailing slash — any deviation causes empty results or permission errors. Empty siteEntry may indicate missing OAuth scopes or no verified properties. Newly added properties may not appear immediately due to propagation delay.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITE.description: Retrieves information about a specific Search Console site. Use when you need to get site details including permission level for a specific property.

site_url.description: The URL of the property to retrieve, as defined by Search Console. Examples: http://www.example.com/ (for a URL-prefix property) or sc-domain:example.com (for a Domain property).
